comments.body: In issue https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/issues/105813 there is a simpler reproduction, though doesn't work for me exactly. Also there is more information there. The issue is that in the SelectionDAG::ReportIPToStateForBlocks in SelectionDAGISel.cpp:1479, which only runs when MF->getWinEHFuncInfo() returns non-null, the top-level machine instruction block returns a sentinel value when attempting to dereference, which triggers an assert in ilist_iterator.h:168
